page.overview:
Who is Hebihime?

Hebihime is notably confident, while she was surprised at the player's ability to break out of her genjutsu, she was still sure of her ability to eliminate them. She is shown to be somewhat delusional, upon meeting her a second time, she states that her enemy ran away last time despite having actually defeated her in their previous encounter.

A woman with long black hair, wearing a formal yellow and purple kimono, Hebihime has dark eyes and pale skin.

Hebihime seems to possess potent genjutsu abilities.

First encountered in the mission "Maid's Genjutsu", Hebihime is a guard at one of Orochimaru's bases. Having thought nobody would ever find the base, she still readily defends it with powerful genjutsu, summoning images of Hashirama and Tobirama Senju to hold off the Konoha ninja infiltrating. When these illusions failed, she entered the battle herself with a pair of guards but was ultimately defeated.
